items.explanation: Polish says "the head hurts me": Boli mnie głowa.
optionNotes: Głowa is the subject, so it stays in the nominative.

items.explanation: Plecy is plural, so the verb is plural: bolą.
optionNotes: Bolę is the ja form: "I hurt".

items.prompt: At the pharmacy: ask for something for a cough.
items.explanation: Medicine for an illness: na + accusative, coś na kaszel.
optionNotes: Na here takes the accusative, kaszel.
Od does not fit here; use na.

items.prompt: The doctor asks: Od kiedy? You have had it for three days.
items.explanation: Od + genitive says since when: od trzech dni.
optionNotes: Od takes the genitive: trzech dni.
Na trzy dni is a plan for the future: "for three days".
Za trzy dni means "in three days", in the future.
